questions.evidence:
PLANETARIUM SATURDAY PROGRAM: Sky Stories begins at ten and lasts forty minutes. It is presented in Chinese with English subtitles. Moon Mission begins at eleven and lasts fifty minutes. Its narration is English, with a Chinese summary sheet available at the entrance.

Each program costs eighty dollars per visitor. A same-day ticket for both costs one hundred and forty. Tickets are for named sessions, not unlimited entry. Doors close when a program starts, and late visitors must book another available session rather than enter in darkness.

Pick up a printed ticket at least ten minutes before the first booked program. Online payment alone is not the printed ticket. The pickup desk opens at nine thirty. Please keep phones silent during programs and avoid using a bright screen in the theater.

The exhibition hall is free and opens from nine to five. It can be visited without a program ticket. The cafe is closed this Saturday, so bring water and plan lunch elsewhere. The information desk can provide a map of nearby public dining areas.
questions.explanation: 需提前十分鐘取票，且開始即關門。

The programs can start only after everyone eats.
